_comment: Cup draws done by hand (e.g. live in the chat). A round listed in `hold` is NOT drawn automatically: the Cup waits until its fixtures appear under `manual`. Give each pairing as two slots (home first): a personKey, or {"winnerOf": "r1-2"} for the winner of an earlier match (match ids are r1-N, r2-N, r3-N in the order listed), so a fixed bracket can be entered once and fills itself in as results arrive. Once a round has been drawn it is saved in cup.json and never redrawn.
